definitions.RTO: Recovery Time Objective (elapsed seconds required to resume read/write service)
definitions.RPO: Recovery Point Objective (data loss horizon in bytes/transactions for acknowledged operations)

failure_class_matrix.class: Class A: Single Node Process SIGKILL
failure_class_matrix.mechanism: Systemd / Supervisor restarts process; WAL and Container index reloaded from disk.
Host reboot; ext4 journal replay; container fsync guarantees committed blocks remain intact.
failure_class_matrix.validation_status: NOT EXECUTED (Simulated via crash points only; bare-metal reboot not authorized)

failure_class_matrix.mechanism: NVMe flush/barrier committed stripes survive power loss. Unsynced page cache discarded.
failure_class_matrix.validation_status: NOT EXECUTED (Physical power interruption requires hardware testing)

failure_class_matrix.class: Class D: Correlated Loss > M=8 Storage Nodes
failure_class_matrix.mechanism: RS(20,12) can tolerate up to 8 lost shards. Exceeding 8 lost shards causes irrecoverable loss.
